verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud platform, since a vendor could ship an on-prem or self-managed version of its stack. However, the evidence only shows Lambda-hosted offerings: On-Demand Cloud, 1-Click Clusters, managed Kubernetes/Slurm, and a single-tenant Private Cloud. None of these lets users run the product on their own infrastructure. Root access and single-tenant clusters are adjacent controls, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
